entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Diablo 3D source-based candidate gold variant item.design.dynamic.gold-large, private attached original ICURS6. Source ICURS6 shows a low irregular compact wider heap of overlapping muted yellow-gold coins, with a raised rear-left stack, overlapping broad discs across middle and two low front/right discs. It is a larger arrangement than small ICURS4 and source medium5, not a treasure mountain. Match THIS source footprint, squat height, partial stacked edges and overlap topology. Occluded total coin number cannot be recovered exactly; do not invent a printed quantity, do not imply one depicted coin equals one unit of gold. Use a restrained approximately seven-coin physical interpretation only as needed to explain visible layered discs, then keep that ONE SAME number and arrangement in every view.
This runtime native range is value >=2500; never letter this range or quantity on the object. Coins are thick squat circular aged muted ochre/yellow gold, softly hammered edges, extremely faint plain worn rim, no readable numerals, portraits, symbols, dragons, gems or modern currency. Do NOT redesign from name or scale up/reuse the small pile. Keep arrangement native-source based, neutral color, simple material.
EXACTLY FIVE separate realistic HD depictions of the SAME stable pile: four large views FRONT (elevated view near source angle), SIDE (true low profile to see thickness/stack), BACK (opposite elevated side), 3-4 (different elevated angle showing same arrangement), plus fifth small NEW HD ICON at the original inventory angle. All complete separated on charcoal-gray background with soft neutral studio light, no dramatic glow or painted floor shadow. Label FRONT/SIDE/BACK/3-4/ICON only, never combine 3-4/ICON. Count and adjacency cannot change between views: rotate the same pile as one group, don't rearrange or add coins for BACK/ICON. Rear surfaces, exact thickness, faint rim and unseen overlaps are cautious proposed inferences. No bags, chests, large mountain, scenery, lettering, magic, sprites or source-pixel inset. ICON wholly NEW HD art, not native pixels, not a runtime icon. Candidate study only.

reference.notes: Referência nativa 6x inspecionada antes da chamada. Fonte privada usada apenas para silhueta/cores; pixels não incorporados.

inferredAreas: Contagem física de moedas parcialmente ocultas, espessura, pilha, borda e verso são interpretações; número de discos não equivale ao valor numérico de ouro.
Regra nativa preservada: value >=2500; GetGoldCursor em Source/items.cpp:2975 e limites Source/items.h:28-29 consultados somente leitura.

coherenceReview.observed: Cinco representações HD novas, moedas ocres sem texto/insígnias e heap baixo; variante distinta do small inicial.
pendingIssues: Prancha não comprova a mesma contagem/adjacência sob rotação: BACK parece rearranjo ou repetição de FRONT; reconciliar mapeamento moeda a moeda antes de master.
Total físico é incerto na fonte pequena; R1 mostra mais camadas/discos do que a proposta aproximada de sete; não promover essa contagem como fato recuperado.
Validar footprint, distinção pequeno/médio/grande e legibilidade na grade lógica nativa de 28px; manter os valores na simulação nativa, sem bags ou malha por quantia.
